reason: The tip and pay proof everyone can see is exactly what I lose techs over, and 30 days free with no contract means I can try it on one slow week without risk. Setup in Vietnamese by phone or Zalo makes it less scary.
objection: My staff are older, they will not learn a new system. If the front desk or techs get confused during a Saturday rush I lose money and I go back to paper.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it run in another Vietnamese salon like mine for a full day, and a promise that someone will come in person in the first week to teach my techs the PIN and pay screens.
